Top right, regimes by who adjusts, read by role, under North money only: the surplus region adjusting or not across the columns, the deficit region adjusting or not down the rows; top left is no rule, bottom right both adjusting. The deficit region is the one whose current account the intervention worsens with no rule, so which of North and South it is changes from one intervention to the next; labelled by name instead, the panels mix the two roles and the effect of the rule largely cancels. Bottom left, who bears the adjustment: the single-region rules by role. When the deficit region has to adjust, dual contraction becomes common; when the surplus region adjusts, it does not occur.

Why the regimes differ: the South content of what is substituted

North intervening, no rule, North money. Left figure: each intervention's response by its size (the length of its response vector in the 48-run space, responses scaled by their sd and the six blocks weighted equally, not centred), its axis (the share of that length in each block) and its sign (the North current account). Right figure: the South content of the good the intervention substitutes away from (primary) and towards (secondary): South output per unit of North final demand for that good, from the Leontief inverse of the baseline input matrix (mean of t = 79-100).

  • Food and wood put the North in deficit. Their secondary good carries more South content than the primary one (food 0.143 to 0.190; wood 0.152 to 0.191), so substitution raises the North's demand on the South: production leakage (sc1, sc12, sc5; sc3 HH-Wood is too small to move the South).
  • Metal and energy put it in surplus. The primary good is the South-intensive one (metal 0.410 to 0.340; energy 0.171 to 0.071), so substitution cuts the North's demand on the South: competitive displacement (sc2, sc8, sc11).
  • Across the twelve, the change in South content correlates -0.60 with the North current account per unit substituted. Food and metal have the same external weight in their response (about a third of its length) but opposite signs; glass and cement act almost only on the ecological block (76% and 93%).

Grid. 180 runs: twelve interventions (sc1-sc12, a 20% substitution from period 70) x who intervenes (North, South, both) x five policies, North/South world under OPENFIX-fiat. Each response is the mean over periods 79-100 of the run's difference from its own no-intervention baseline. South emissions corrected ex post (D-77). Analysis tag 20261121_ce79; no simulation is run by this page.
